out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the hand sink to the right of the 3 vat sink was being used to store plastic baskets that food is served in if a customer is eating at facility.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL HAND SINKS MUST BE CLEAR AND FREE FOR EMPLOYEES TO WASH HANDS AT ALL TIMES. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE REMOVE PLASTIC BASKETS FROM HAND SINK.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located to the left of the 3 vat sink is blocked by dirty dishes preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC WHY HAND SINKS CAN NEVER BE BLOCKED TO HELP PREVENT CONTAMINATION OF DIFFERENCE FOODS AND HELP PREVENT THE POTENTIAL SPREAD OF FOOD BORNE ILLNESSES. PIC MOVED DIRTY DISHES OUTSIDE OF HAND SINK TO BE WASHED.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: multiple items in the walk-in refrigerator where not labeled with a date mark.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC WHY FOODS KEPT FOR 24 HOURS NEED TO HAVE A DATE MARK ON THEM. PIC TOLD EHS THEY WILL BUY DATE MARKING LABELS AND BEGIN LABELING ANY FOODS KEPT LONGER THAN 24 HOURS.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: multiple bulk food items were being scooped and portioned out by bowls without handles.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC WHY BOWLS CANNOT BE USED TO PORTION OUT FOOD BEING STORED IN BULK. PIC WILL PURCHASE SCOOPS WITH HANDLES BEFORE NEXT INSPECTION.
